name: render-vo-anchored-motion-listicle
description: Assemble a narrated motion-graphic listicle video ad from a config: a voiceover (cloned or cast, in the chosen tone) reads a numbered list while N animated web-graphic beats in one branded design system (alternating tiles, big numerals, callouts) are rendered frame by frame and timed to the voiceover's words. Optional B-roll windows (a brand clip, an AI clip or a motion graphic) give the eye a break, and captions appear only inside those windows, with the voiceover mixed over a low music bed. Free, deterministic assembly; the voiceover, music and any AI clips come from create-vo-elevenlabs, create-music-elevenlabs and create-video-fal. Use for the vo-anchored-motion-listicle format.
